spans.s:
(इर) तुहिर r. 1st cl. (तोहति)
To hurt or give pain, to kill.

Moon-light, moonshine.
E.
तुह to give pain, इनन् Uṇādi aff.

m. (-लः)
The Himālaya mountains.
E.
तुहिन, and शैल a mountain; also similar compounds, as तुहिनपर्व्वत, &c.

m. (-शुः)
The moon.
E.
तुहिन cold, अंशु a ray.

n. (-लं)
Camphor.
E.
तुहिनांशु, and तैल oil.

m. (-द्रिः)
The Himālaya mountains.
E.
तुहिन, and अद्रि a mountain; also तुहिनशैल, &c.
